subject: eng
title: Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.explain: 星期幾（on Mondays = every Monday）前面用介詞 on。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Mandy goes to Brownies ___ Mondays.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.q: Look! Alan ___ his bicycle in the park right now.
questions.explain: 看到 Look! 和 right now 表示此刻正在發生，用現在進行式 is riding。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Look! Alan ___ his bicycle in the park right now.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.q: Cathy has lunch ___ twelve fifty-five ___ the afternoon.
questions.explain: 具體時間點用 at（at twelve fifty-five）；早上／下午／晚上用 in（in the afternoon）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Cathy has lunch ___ twelve fifty-five ___ the afternoon.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.q: Mr Lam goes to bed ___ ten thirty ___ night.
questions.explain: 具體時刻用 at ten thirty；「在晚上（night）」固定用 at night。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Mr Lam goes to bed ___ ten thirty ___ night.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.q: ___ does Betty do her homework? She does her homework at four forty-five.
questions.explain: 回答是具體時間（at four forty-five），問句用 What time（幾點）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ does Betty do her homework? She does her homework at four forty-five.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.q: Correct the mistake: 'Amy sweeps the floor on every Sunday.' -> Write the correct time phrase without preposition:
questions.explain: every / this / today 前面不可加介詞 on，直接寫 every Sunday。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Correct the mistake: 'Amy sweeps the floor on every Sunday.' -> Write the correct time phrase without preposition:
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time

questions.q: 'What do Sally do on Fridays?' is grammatically correct.
questions.explain: Sally 是第三人稱單數，助動詞必須用 does（What does Sally do on Fridays?）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: 'What do Sally do on Fridays?' is grammatically correct.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 3–4: Time Prepositions, Tenses & What time
